subject: Darkmantle
picture: A darkmantle hangs from a cave ceiling like a stone stalactite, then shows a simple squid-like underside with a few large tentacle shapes. It should look like cave rock from above and a small squid from below. Cave ceiling with a few stalactites, rock walls, large floor stones, closed tunnel. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02.
